release: PAR2 Repair Visibility, SAB 5.1.2 & Selected Episode Monitoring
name: PAR2 Repair Visibility, SAB 5.1.2 & Selected Episode Monitoring
changes: Adds TV Selected Episodes monitoring so users can explicitly monitor whole seasons or individual episodes, including old aired episodes, without implicitly monitoring other seasons.
Explicit Selected Episodes are immediately eligible for Continuous Automation even when Search existing missing backlog is off; partial selections never trigger whole-season pack downloads.
Persists observable SAB Verify/PAR2/Repair evidence into NewzDeck Completed and Failed download records without changing SAB's repair/recoverability decisions.
Classifies terminal failures as unrecoverable-data, unpack, password, filesystem, post-processing-aborted, or other when SAB's own status/log/fail_message supports that distinction.
Shows PAR2 outcome, repair attempted, extra PAR2 fetch observation, post-processing time, and bounded SAB repair-history messages in Download details and copied diagnostics.
Stops presenting unavailable SAB recovery-block counts as real zeroes; the UI explicitly says Not reported by SAB when exact counts are unavailable.

Upgrades the private pinned SABnzbd runtime from 5.1.1 to 5.1.2 using the official win64 portable asset and SHA-256, with a graceful same-admin queue-preserving startup handoff and no force-kill path.
Preserves v3.6.46 quality-aware release selection, v3.6.45 scan progress, strict TV identity, Library Integrity, Smart Import, and Downloads continuity behavior.
regression_guards: Selected Episodes regression tests verify empty first-entry selection, Season 3-only monitoring, old-episode automatic eligibility, partial-selection pack suppression, and dormant selection restoration.
Synthetic SAB history verifies completed-with-repair, completed-after-verify, active PAR2 fetch, unrecoverable cannot-complete, password, unpack, and filesystem classifications.
Terminal repair telemetry is persisted with terminal NewzDeck job state so reconnect/restart cards retain the observed outcome.
Pinned SAB runtime must be 5.1.2 with official win64 URL and SHA-256 0a48cc87023f054130758a114158e0f17f32152e8ff9158eef49cf73be04be46.
The managed SAB upgrade path provisions before graceful shutdown, waits for authoritative port release, and contains no force-kill operation for an already-running prior SAB generation.
The 30 strict TV identity cases, Library Integrity safety, scan-progress guards, and v3.6.46 quality-selection guards remain mandatory.
